title: Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences in pictures
specs: 560 m total (developer’s brochure, vertical diagram; 557 m on Wikipedia)

Central Park Tower, New York (472.4 m, 98 floors), 432 Park Avenue (425.7 m), Princess Tower (414 m), 23 Marina (393 m), Elite Residence (381 m) and The Marina Torch (352 m), as compared in the brochure

6 basements + ground + 5 podium levels, then a swimming-pool floor, a service floor and Sky Garden 1, 83 residential floors (with 6 mechanical floors between them), the VIP Sky Lounge, the spa and pool, the gym and the penthouses up to level 103 (brochure vertical diagram)
Emerald and Sapphire Villas levels 12–48 · Ruby Villas 49–82 · Diamond and Fleurs de Jardin Sky Mansions 83–96 · Astronomia Sky Penthouses 100–101 · The Billionaire Sky Penthouse 102–103
18,700 sq ft, with 1 to 4 homes a floor

Emerald, Sapphire and Ruby villas (quarter floors), Diamond and Fleurs de Jardin Sky Mansions (half floors, levels 83–96), Astronomia Sky Penthouses (full floors) and the Billionaire Sky Penthouse (top two floors)
Every home has its own pool

Three swimming pools, lobby lounge, events hall, café bar, chef’s table and games room; Swimming Pool 01 (34 × 9 m, with a 9 × 9 m kids’ pool) low in the tower; near the summit the 643 sq m VIP Sky Lounge (level 97), the 1,200 sq m spa with the stratospheric infinity pool (level 98) and the 897 sq m gym (level 99); 4 sky gardens
Concierge, chauffeur, butler, bodyguard, private chef, daycare, housekeeping, spa and personal training; titanium access card
2 bays for each 2 to 3-bedroom villa, 4 for a 6-bedroom mansion, 6 for an Astronomia penthouse and 12 for the Billionaire penthouse
Architectural concept: Muhammad Binghatti · lifestyle concept and interior design: Jacob Arabo · architectural details and interior design: Roman Vnoukov, exclusively for Jacob & Co (brochure)

Calacatta Borghini, Nero Marquina, Black River and Asian St. Laurent marble, glossy brass, brushed and ripple-finish stainless steel, white fluted and scalloped wood panels, mirror, tinted brown and violet glass, dusky, royal and sapphire-blue velvet, black leather and snake-skin textures; interiors inspired by Jacob & Co. jewellery and watches
